scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace @mezosbot/game-core && npm run build --workspace @mezosbot/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.dev: npm run build:deps && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:deps && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && wrangler deploy
